name: orbital-archive-reader
description: Hostile-input ZIP reader for Meta data exports, via uniffi-bindgen-react-native (#920)
author: Pure Karma Labs

scripts.comment:entrypoint: ubrn's own loader is src/bindings.tsx (turboModule.entrypoint), NOT src/index.tsx. src/index.tsx is the hand-written wrapper and the package main; ubrn must never write it. See ubrn.config.yaml.
scripts.comment:marker: build:ios[:release] write rust-profile-ios.txt via the SHARED writer scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh with the `archive` selector (rationale, incl. the deliberate pre-build rm -f, lives in its header). build:android[:release] write the jniLibs/rust-profile.txt marker the checkArchiveRustBinaries gradle task reads.
scripts.build:ios: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && bash ../../scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh debug archive
scripts.build:ios:release: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && bash ../../scripts/write-rust-marker-ios.sh release archive
scripts.build:android: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && echo debug > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
scripts.build:android:release: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && echo release > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
